judgment: On the road, holding firm: good.
image: So the noble one is clear and careful in punishments,
lines: and that is how he gets his disaster.
his money held to his chest,
and he gets a young servant who holds firm.
and he loses his young servant.
Travelling, he rests at a place
and gets his money and his axe.
But my heart is not glad.
He shoots a pheasant, and one arrow is lost.
In the end he wins praise, and a posting.
He loses a cow, in his ease. Misfortune.

notes.name_en: 旅 is the sojourner away from home; 'Travelling' (the state, not Wilhelm's person 'The Wanderer').
notes.L5: 譽命 praise and an official charge/appointment — 'a posting'.
notes.L6: 喪牛于易: 易 as ease again (cf. 34 L5), loss through carelessness at rest.
notes.L2: 得童僕貞: 貞 now read with the servant ('a young servant who holds firm'); A left 'Holding firm.' as a bare tag.
